policy-v1.5.4.review: Read-only repository metadata/structure scanner and Ruff lint/format; no runtime/scientific imports or tests.
policy-v1.5.4.workflow_content:
name: MolSysSuite policy conformance

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out member repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up policy Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"
      - name: Check out MolSysSuite policy
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: uibcdf/molsyssuite
          ref: policy-v1.5.4
          path: .molsyssuite-policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check repository conformance
        run: >-
          python .molsyssuite-policy/devtools/scripts/check_repository.py .
          --repository "${{ github.repository }}" --skip-guide-content
      - name: Install the policy Ruff version
        run: >-
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check
          "ruff==$(python -c 'import tomllib; from pathlib import Path; print(tomllib.loads(Path(".molsyssuite-policy/suite.toml").read_text())["policies"]["python-quality"]["ruff-version"])')"
      - name: Check Python lint and imports
        run: ruff check --force-exclude --exclude .molsyssuite-policy .
      - name: Check Python formatting
        run: ruff format --check --force-exclude --exclude .molsyssuite-policy .

policy-v1.5.6.review: Read-only repository metadata/structure scanner and Ruff lint/format; no runtime/scientific imports or tests.
policy-v1.5.6.workflow_content:
name: MolSysSuite policy conformance

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      admission_sha:
        description: Optional full central commit admitting a member absent from this policy
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out member repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up policy Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"
      - name: Check out MolSysSuite policy
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: uibcdf/molsyssuite
          ref: policy-v1.5.6
          path: .molsyssuite-policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate immutable admission input
        if: inputs.admission_sha != ''
        env:
          ADMISSION_SHA: ${{ inputs.admission_sha }}
        run: |
          python -c 'import os, re; assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", os.environ["ADMISSION_SHA"]), "admission_sha must be a full commit"'
      - name: Check out central admission data
        if: inputs.admission_sha != ''
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: uibcdf/molsyssuite
          ref: ${{ inputs.admission_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: .molsyssuite-admission
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check repository conformance
        env:
          ADMISSION_SHA: ${{ inputs.admission_sha }}
          MEMBER_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          arguments=(. --repository "$MEMBER_REPOSITORY" --skip-guide-content)
          if [ -n "$ADMISSION_SHA" ]; then
            arguments+=(--admission-root .molsyssuite-admission --admission-sha "$ADMISSION_SHA")
          fi
          python .molsyssuite-policy/devtools/scripts/check_repository.py "${arguments[@]}"
      - name: Install the policy Ruff version
        run: >-
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check
          "ruff==$(python -c 'import tomllib; from pathlib import Path; print(tomllib.loads(Path(".molsyssuite-policy/suite.toml").read_text())["policies"]["python-quality"]["ruff-version"])')"
      - name: Check Python lint and imports
        run: ruff check --force-exclude --exclude .molsyssuite-policy --exclude .molsyssuite-admission .
      - name: Check Python formatting
        run: ruff format --check --force-exclude --exclude .molsyssuite-policy --exclude .molsyssuite-admission .
